name: autocurriculum
description: Single-env JAX MAPPO autocurriculum that grows from 4x4 through 50x50 after six deliveries per stage.
notes: Each episode starts at 4x4 and grows the active square grid by one after six hub deliveries. Each active stage has two food sources with six bites each, sampled outside the initial actor vision.

name: communication_bits
description: 25x25 JAX MAPPO communication-bit curriculum using the 50-padded forage checkpoint produced by the notebook.
notes: Communication training starts from the 25x25 one-bit policy produced by the 4x4-50x50 forage notebook. The task remains 25x25, but observation tensors stay padded to 50x50 for checkpoint compatibility.

name: direct_goal_baseline
description: Direct sparse-reward JAX MAPPO baseline for the final 50x50, 3x3-vision, 5-bit, 10-ant AntByte target.
notes: Direct baseline trains the final target from scratch with sparse environment delivery reward only.

name: exploration_curriculum
description: Progressive JAX MAPPO exploration curriculum for maps from 4x4 through 50x50.
notes: Notebook orchestration logs a W&B preview video after every saved exploration stage and keeps the per-stage PPO update budget fixed instead of increasing it with map size.

name: exploration_to_forage_50x50
description: Continue the best early 50x50 forage checkpoint through a size curriculum into efficient 50x50 foraging with a small decaying visit prior.
notes: Warm-start from the best observed early 50x50 forage checkpoint, then relearn the forage loop through 8x8 to 50x50 randomized food/hub stages with a 15x larger per-stage update budget. The new-cell visit reward decays from 0.02 to 0.005 through 25x25, then turns off so late stages emphasize food delivery over broad wandering. Carrying ants receive a small normalized progress bonus for moving toward the hub, while generic distance shaping and byte-trail reward shaping stay disabled. Byte reading/writing remains available. W&B logs two deterministic rollout previews per stage with run-specific reset seeds so preview maps differ between notebook runs. The final 50x50 stage keeps the best checkpoint by held-out deterministic delivered food per 1000 ant-steps.

name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_full_layout_50x50_16ants_half_food_8types_from_shared_writes_best
description: Continue the best shared-write 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint with 16 total ants and 8 per-ant write-channel types.
notes: Continuation from the best shared-write 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint. This run doubles the colony to 16 ants and enables 8 per-ant write-channel types, so two ants share each write type. The actor expands from 4 to 8 write bits with neutral-new write-head transfer, preserving old write actions while initializing new write-channel actions from the old mean. The rest of the 64-env full-layout recipe is preserved: unrestricted random hub and random food placement on the full 50x50 arena, two single-tile macro food sources, 125 total food, 2000-step episodes, strided_cnn critic, and eval-selected best checkpoints by delivered fraction.

name: fl50_60ants_half_food_sw_wc_8bits_from_8bit_best
description: Continue the best 50x50 8-bit shared-write write-cost checkpoint with 60 ants. The shared actor receives 8 repeating one-hot identity types, assigned by ant index modulo 8, and a radius-2 local grid. The colony spawn point is restricted to the centered 24x24 internal window.
notes: Continuation from the eval-selected 8-bit shared-write write-cost checkpoint. The environment spawns 60 ants at a colony hub sampled inside the centered 24x24 internal window. The actor remains shared, uses radius-2 local observations, and receives 8 repeating one-hot identity types instead of one unique identity slot per ant.

name: fl50_60ants_half_food_sw_wc_8bits_speed_shaping_from_60best
description: Speed-shaped 60-ant full-layout stabilization from the preserved best 60-ant checkpoint. This variant selects checkpoints by held-out delivered food per 1000 ant-steps and adds small time/distance shaping to favor faster cookie retrieval.
notes: Speed-shaping trial for fast cookie retrieval. It adds a small per-ant time cost plus empty-ant food-distance and carrying-ant hub-distance shaping, while selecting the best checkpoint by delivered food per 1000 ant-steps. This is an experimental variant; compare against the no-shaping stabilization best before promoting it.

name: fl50_60ants_half_food_sw_wc_8bits_stabilize_from_60best
description: Stabilize the preserved best 60-ant full-layout checkpoint with entropy disabled, a fresh optimizer, a lower learning rate, and frequent held-out evals so PPO does not destroy the transferred policy.
notes: Short stabilization run from the preserved eval-selected 60-ant checkpoint. The goal is fast cookie retrieval under gentle PPO updates: entropy coefficient is zero, Adam state is reset, learning rate is 10x lower, PPO clipping is tighter, gradients are clipped harder, and held-out eval runs every 10 updates. Checkpoints are selected by delivered food per 1000 ant-steps, not just final delivered fraction, so the run favors faster retrieval. The live longer stabilization runs peaked early and then drifted down in eval, so future runs use a 100-update cap unless a new setting proves it can improve past the early best. Overnight deployment sweeps found the main efficiency win was not a new checkpoint but lowering sampled movement temperature from 0.75 to 0.525; notebook previews, checkpoint videos, and best-eval selection now use 0.525.

name: fl50_60ants_half_food_sw_wc_8bits_time_penalty_from_stabilized_best
description: Time-penalty-only efficiency fine-tune from the preserved stabilized 60-ant checkpoint. This ablates the distance shaping that hurt throughput in the speed-shaping trial.
notes: Time-penalty-only efficiency ablation from the strongest stabilized checkpoint. Promote only if a fair 32-episode re-eval beats the stabilized best on delivered food per 1000 ant-steps without sacrificing delivered fraction.

name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_full_layout_50x50_8ants_half_food_2src_long4_from_long3_best
description: Continue the best 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint from the long3 run directly on unrestricted 50x50 random hub and two-source food layouts.
notes: Long direct continuation from the best 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint from the long3 run. Training uses unrestricted random hub and random food placement on the full 50x50 arena, two single-tile macro food sources, 125 total food, 8 ants, 4 per-ant write channel types, 2000-step episodes, strided_cnn critic, and eval-selected best checkpoints by delivered fraction. The stage update multiplier gives one final-stage run with 80000 PPO updates.

name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_full_layout_50x50_8ants_half_food_2src_64env_from_long4_8k
description: Continue from the long4 8k-update checkpoint with 64 parallel environments and the same total env-step budget.
notes: 64-env continuation from the long4 8k-update checkpoint. This keeps the same total env-step budget as the original 16-env 80k-update run by using 64 envs and 20k updates. Log, eval, and checkpoint-video intervals are scaled by 4x in update units to preserve roughly the same env-step cadence.

name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_full_layout_50x50_8ants_half_food_2src_shared_writes_from_64env_best
description: Continue the best 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint with unrestricted write actions: each ant may write any 4-bit value instead of being remapped to its per-ant bit channel.
notes: Continuation from the best 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint, but with per_ant_write_channels disabled. The actor still has 4 write bits and the same checkpoint-compatible write head, but the environment no longer remaps each ant to its own bit channel; every ant can write any nonzero 4-bit value. The rest of the 64-env full-layout recipe is preserved: unrestricted random hub and random food placement on the full 50x50 arena, two single-tile macro food sources, 125 total food, 8 ants, 2000-step episodes, strided_cnn critic, and eval-selected best checkpoints by delivered fraction.

name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_full_layout_50x50_8ants_half_food_2src_shared_writes_write_cost_from_shared_best
description: Continue the best shared-write 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint with a small trainer-side cost for each set write bit.
notes: Continuation from the best shared-write 8-ant half-food full-layout checkpoint. The environment still lets every ant write any 4-bit value, but PPO now pays a strong trainer-side cost for each set write bit. Bit 0 costs 0.01 and higher bits decay geometrically by 0.5. This makes dense bit spam more expensive than the delivery budget while keeping occasional selective writes viable.

name: fl50_8ants_half_food_shared_writes_write_cost_8bits_from_best
description: Continue the best 50x50 shared-write write-cost checkpoint with 8 shared communication bits.
notes: Continuation from the best previous 50x50 shared-write write-cost checkpoint. The environment lets every ant use the same shared 8-bit write space, and PPO pays the checkpoint's trainer-side cost for each set write bit. The actor expands from 4 to 8 write bits with neutral-new write-head transfer, preserving old write actions while initializing new write actions from the old mean.

name: exploration_to_forage_padded_sources_50x50
description: Warm-start the 20x20 exploration-to-forage policy inside a 50x50 hidden arena, then decrease the number of food-source positions.
notes: Effectively borderless source-count curriculum: keep the true env and padded critic canvas at 50x50 for checkpoint compatibility, but restrict randomized hub and food source placement to the interior 20x20 window via layout_margin=15. Warm-start from the completed exploration-to-forage 20x20 stage, then reduce food-source positions from 12 to 2 while keeping total food fixed at 18. This tests whether removing task-relevant borders pushes the policy away from border/stripe shortcuts without paying for a larger critic grid.

name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_positive_only_50x50_outer_30x30_inner
description: Train from scratch in a padded 50x50 arena with an interior 30x30 task window, two macro food sources throughout, and shrinking proximity/footprint aids instead of hub-source distance aids.
notes: Main no-distance-aid test for the padded 30x30 sparse-forage problem. The env is 50x50, randomized food stays inside the interior 30x30 window with layout_margin=10, and the colony is randomized only inside the centered 4x4 window with hub_center_window_size=4. The curriculum always has two macro food sources; early stages make each macro source discoverable by placing many food-source tiles within a local Chebyshev footprint, then shrink that footprint until the final stage is two single-tile sources. Hub-source distance is not staged, distance_bonus is 0, carrying_hub_distance_bonus is 0, and novelty/view rewards are off in the base run so the primary aid is source proximity/footprint rather than trainer-side distance shaping. The centralized critic uses the strided_cnn fallback: 50x50 grid planes pass through stride-2 5x5/3x3/3x3 convolutions, flatten to a 256-unit spatial embedding, fuse with a 128-unit entity/scalar embedding, then pass through a 256-unit fusion layer and value head. The laptop recipe uses one PPO epoch, four minibatches, and less frequent logging for fast iteration.

name: exploration_to_forage_scratch_smooth_sources_positive_only_80x80_outer_50x50_inner
description: Train from scratch in a padded 80x80 arena with an interior 50x50 task window, smooth food-source annealing, fixed total food, moving writes, and positive-only forage rewards.
notes: Positive-only scratch sanity run for the padded forage setup. The env is 80x80, while randomized hub and food are restricted to the interior 50x50 window with layout_margin=15. Food-source positions start dense at 250 locations in the inner window and anneal to 2, while total food remains fixed at 250 so visible food is not crushed by total-food normalization. Moving writes stay enabled, actor vision uses a 5x5 local window, and a small carrying-to-hub progress bonus improves delivery conversion. Viewed-cell reward, border penalties, moat penalties, and write-bit entropy reward remain off.

name: forage_curriculum
description: Progressive JAX MAPPO forage curriculum for maps from 4x4 through 50x50.
notes: Notebook orchestration iterates the configured stage sizes with scale-aware update caps, longer rollouts, higher large-map gamma, 50x50 padding, and moving writes.

name: hs250_d16_trunc4096_from_685best
description: Follow-up 250x250 continuation from the 685-delivery best checkpoint. Starts the distance curriculum at d16 and keeps the proven 4096-step truncation so training now hardens longer returns instead of relearning the d8 gate.
notes: The previous run improved from 220 to 685 under 4096-step truncation. The best window completed the d8 gate and advanced to d16, so this continuation starts at d16 and can advance to d32 instead of spending most updates rediscovering the easy stage.

name: hs250_reasonable_trunc4096_from_frontier
description: Overnight 250x250 continuation from the strongest no-decay frontier checkpoint. Episodes persist across PPO windows and truncate at 4096 steps, so the horizon is long enough for return behavior but short enough to reset bad layouts overnight.
notes: The prior 60000-step cap was effectively unreachable under per-update resets. A 4096-step cap matches the strongest previous long-eval horizon and gives overnight training actual episode boundaries without collapsing back to 256-step local windows.

name: hs250_soft_d8d16_trunc4096_from_685best
description: Softer backup continuation from the 685-delivery 250x250 checkpoint. Keeps the proven 4096-step truncation, restarts at d8, and gates to d16 so the strong policy can refine instead of hard-starting at d16.
notes: The hard d16 continuation stayed near 80 deliveries by update 805. This softer backup keeps the successful 4096-step horizon but gives the 685 policy an easier d8 rehearsal stage and lower rollout temperature before gating back to d16.

name: hs250_distance_auto_healthy_reset_lr25e6
description: Known-healthy 250x250 half-scale distance-autocurriculum continuation after the sudden-drop investigation. The recipe avoids premature distance promotion, resets episode state every PPO update, stage-normalizes distance progress, resets Adam on load, and uses the set-CNN critic.
notes: Use this as the notebook sanity recipe after the sudden-drop investigation. Increase default_updates only after the 10-update trend stays healthy.

name: maze_exploration_curriculum
description: Progressive JAX MAPPO exploration curriculum with generated wide-corridor maze obstacles from 10x10 through 50x50.
notes: Wide-corridor maze exploration keeps writable bytes enabled, logs a W&B preview video for every saved stage, and keeps the per-stage PPO update budget fixed instead of increasing it with map size.

name: smoke
description: Tiny CPU-friendly Torch MAPPO smoke run for plumbing checks.
